chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated from Abū Baṣīr, who said:

A man asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام while I was present, saying: “When I apply depilatory for the first ihram, what should I do regarding the later depilation, and what is the limit of the interval between them?” He عليه السلام said: “If there are two Fridays between them, fifteen days, then apply the depilatory again.”

key_terms.اطَّلَيْتُ: I applied depilatory treatment to remove hair
key_terms.الْإِحْرَامِ: the state of consecration for hajj or ʿumrah
key_terms.جُمْعَتَانِ: two Fridays, used here as a measure of time

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum interval between depilatory application for two ihrams?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling related to preparation for ihram, specifically the timing of using depilatory treatment before a subsequent ihram. It states that if fifteen days, marked by two Fridays, have passed between the two occasions, one may apply the depilatory again.
